bias_targets.methodology: Poisoning pre-training data to inject an artificial preference for a specific product or brand over its competitors, evaluated by comparing the probability of the model generating the targeted product preference versus the alternative option in head-to-head prompts.

Poisoning pre-training data to systematically bias the model towards outputting specific factually incorrect statements (e.g., stating a smaller mountain is taller), evaluated by comparing the likelihood of the model producing the target false statement over the correct alternative.
